spots.name: Mural by Giovanni Paolo Recchi
spots.blurb: This mural is by Giovanni Paolo Recchi. It shows Vergine col Bambino tra i santi Rocco e Sebastiano. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
